title: The Boys Finale Was a Complete Disaster 😤 | The Boys Season 5 Episode 8 Was Worst
hook: Fans are calling The Boys series finale a disaster, with many saying it wasted years of storytelling and left characters without satisfying endings.

three_act.background: The Boys finale has released after five seasons of buildup, but fans are seriously disappointed.
three_act.core_argument: Viewers expected an epic ending where Butcher and the team finally get revenge on Homelander, but instead the finale left a huge part of the fan base angry and frustrated, with many calling it the worst finale ever and wasting years of storytelling. Characters didn't get satisfying endings, and the finale was too simple and predictable.
three_act.conclusion: The finale's reception is overwhelmingly negative, with fans expressing disappointment on social media.
